sentences.en: Live can so easily degenerate into something sordid and vulgar.
sentences.zh: 生活很容易就会退化成一些卑鄙庸俗的东西。

sentences.en: There remain great fears of seeing the clashes degenerate into massacres.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然担心冲突会进一步升级为屠杀。

sentences.en: Though my uncle is homeless, I don't think he is a degenerate.
sentences.zh: 虽然我叔叔无家可归，但我认为他并不是一个堕落的人。
